explication: 🤗 Datasets loads public Hub datasets or local files, optionally streams them, builds typed Arrow-backed datasets, and exposes them for preprocessing and model use. The core path runs from the user through load_dataset and a format-specific builder, with download/streaming support and Arrow storage; Dataset operations then transform data, and formatters decode it for consumers. Search indexes, Hub publishing, and the broad set of packaged formats and multimodal features are additional capabilities. The graph reflects documented capabilities where implementation excerpts were unavailable; those links are omitted when call ownership is uncertain.
